verdict.rationale: The evidence describes ReelMimic as a local app driven through a web UI (home page, chat panel, Production line tab, on-video comments), with no documented public HTTP or programmatic API for creating or controlling jobs. The only scriptable surfaces are a narrow `npm run post-video` publishing command and an `npm run doctor` setup check. These are adjacent CLI utilities, not a documented public API for driving the product, so they earn no credit.
